# FARA — The Arakan Village Name Archive

> FARA ("fará" means "village" in the Rohingya language) is a public archive of the names and locations of 1,023 Rohingya villages in Arakan (Rakhine State, Myanmar). Each record gives the village's Rohingya name, its official romanised name, its Burmese-script name where known, its village tract, township and district, and its coordinates. Every village had a name; FARA exists so those names are never erased.

Rohingya village names are being renamed, depopulated and removed from official maps. FARA keeps them on record for research, reporting, human-rights documentation and the Rohingya community. It is a project by AB Aziz (ab@rohingya.ro).

## Facts
- 1,023 villages in four townships: Maungdaw (378), Buthidaung (338), Rathedaung (214), Sittwe (93).
- Source data: Rohingya Khobor — Arakan Maps Project (https://map.rohingyakhobor.com/map), collected 2 July 2026.
- 725 villages have a recorded Rohingya name; 645 have a Burmese-script name. Missing names are stated as missing, not guessed.
- Records with known data problems are flagged, never silently altered. One record has unverified coordinates.
- Coordinates are decimal degrees, WGS84.
- Each village also carries what UNOSAT's satellite analysis of 31 August – 11 October 2017 marked at or near it: destroyed, destruction nearby, none detected, or not assessed. "None detected" does not mean the village is standing; the imagery ends on 11 October 2017 and the analysis was not validated on the ground.
- 1,017 villages carry their official MIMU place code (P-code), with village tract, township and district codes, from MIMU Place Codes, Release 9.7 (January 2026). Villages MIMU has dropped from its list are marked inactive; villages with no official code are stated as having none.

## How the site is organised
- [Interactive map](https://map.rohingya.ro/): search in Rohingya, English or Burmese; satellite imagery with capture dates, earlier captures and the latest Sentinel-2 pass for every village.
- [All villages, A–Z](https://map.rohingya.ro/villages/)
- [Maungdaw township](https://map.rohingya.ro/township/maungdaw/)
- [Buthidaung township](https://map.rohingya.ro/township/buthidaung/)
- [Rathedaung township](https://map.rohingya.ro/township/rathedaung/)
- [Sittwe township](https://map.rohingya.ro/township/sittwe/)
- One page per village at https://map.rohingya.ro/village/<id>-<name>/ with names, location, nearby villages and a short question-and-answer section.

## Data
- [CSV](https://map.rohingya.ro/arakan_villages.csv)
- [JSON](https://map.rohingya.ro/arakan_villages.json)
- [GeoJSON](https://map.rohingya.ro/arakan_villages.geojson) (verified coordinates only)
- [2017 destruction per village, CSV](https://map.rohingya.ro/status_unosat_2017.csv) and [the destroyed zones, GeoJSON](https://map.rohingya.ro/unosat_2017_zones.geojson): derived from UNOSAT data, CC BY-SA 4.0, credit UNOSAT
- Fields: id, name (official romanised), rohingya_name, village_name_mmr (Burmese script), lat, lng, village_tract, township, district, coord_status, pcode_village, pcode_village_tract, pcode_township, pcode_district, mimu_village_name, mimu_village_tract_name, mimu_village_status, mimu_village_tract_status, pcode_match.
- [Place-code matching, record by record](https://map.rohingya.ro/pcodes.csv): how each code was matched, and the few records still to be confirmed.

## Citing
Cite a record as: FARA — The Arakan Village Name Archive, record FARA-<id>, "<village name>", followed by the page URL.
